verdict.rationale: A direct probe got HTTP 200 at https://developers.deepgram.com/openapi.json, and the response contains an "openapi" key. That confirms a downloadable, machine-readable OpenAPI spec is published on the official docs domain. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or linking the spec, and evidence of how much it covers (e.g., whether the streaming/WebSocket agent APIs are included) or how it is versioned.
